title: How to Export Minecraft Mobile World using PC (Bedrock)
topic: Minecraft Bedrock mobile world ko Windows PC par backup ya doosre device par transfer karna hai?
description: Minecraft Bedrock mobile world ko Windows PC par backup ya doosre device par transfer karna hai? Is video mein Android phone ko PC se connect karke Minecraft world files tak pahunchne ka file-transfer workflow dikhaya gaya hai. World backup rakhna game reinstall, device change ya save corruption ke risk se pehle useful ho sakta hai. Video record ke mutabiq method Windows 11 PC par test kiya gaya tha; har Android version par file access same nahi hota.
